reviewer_statement: Author-side frozen Python 1.2 scientific source parity review of windowed_rqa_functional_mean_band. Existing extensive direct differential evidence in tests/testthat/test-native-functional-rqa-recovery.R remains. New full-frame/derived-curve/seeded-band source fixture proposes four complete source RQA sensitivity configurations and three unit/metadata band configurations, covering zero-column empty pairwise returns and source wrapper provenance. Exact-head CI and independent certification are not established.
native_language_semantic_policy: Python dataclass result tuples, pandas tables, NumPy arrays and scientific provenance maps are represented by native R S3/list, data.frame and atomic/matrix/array fields with retained source mathematical semantics. PCG64 parity is assessed through seeded source comparisons and no Python is invoked in native R.

case_evidence.description: Frozen published eyetrajectoriespy==1.2.0 src/eyetrajectoriespy/functional_rqa.py::windowed_rqa_functional_mean_band; source typed windowed RQA results and native R semantic list counterpart.

Four scientifically distinct sensitivity source inputs (single sample specification, two sample specifications with multiple RQA metrics, physical-time windows with multi-channel selected dimension, target-density resolution), and three unit-level seeded band inputs (curve, participant and retained caller participant column under curve unit).

Full source design, descriptive summary and pairwise tables including the 0x0 single-specification empty pairwise pandas frame; entire derived functional RQA values and time grids, provenance, curve/participant band means, standard errors, 100-draw seeded PCG64 maximum statistics, critical values, bounds, per-unit counts and unique unit identities.

Native R rejects Boolean, malformed and duplicate resolved window-step specifications, ambiguous radius vs target-rate contracts, wrong inference unit, unsupported independent-block claims; original source type/exception identities remain language-specific.

Python WindowedRQASensitivityResult and WindowedRQAMeanBandResult dataclasses map to ordered native R S3 source result lists; three source-ordered data.frame schemas (with 0x0 empty pairwise condition) plus full functional trajectory grid and nested inference-band provenance.

Simultaneous observed-grid multiplier mean band on complete derived RQA functions, retaining curve versus equal-weight participant inference, covariance over derived time-grid functions, NumPy PCG64 seeded Gaussian multipliers and a nonrow-bootstrap joint maximum statistic.

independent_review_status: Provisional author full-source semantic review only; frozen Python 1.2 and Linux/macOS/Windows exact-head CI pending; zero independent certifications.
language_specific_limits: Python immutable dataclass class/tuple/pandas index identity and exact Python exception classes are not native R runtime identities
Temporal sliding-window dependence is not removed by duplicate-sample reuse accounting; mean-band inference depends on independent curve or participant units
NumPy/random generator compatibility for arbitrary seeds and all platforms requires full exact-head CI and additional certification beyond seeded 100-draw tests
No RQA automatic specification selection, false independent-window resampling or mathematical inferential guarantee is claimed
